title: Putriciel
subtitle: The Befouled Saint
text: A wandering purifier who could set the heat of his own blood closely enough to burn infection out of wounds, relics, buildings and fields, Erythrocytic Mycelium included, and leave the rest standing. The censers and the offering hand recovered from the tomb were his working tools. He did not know that each cleansing drew some of the infection into his blood. Dark eschar wounds came first, then pale shelf fungus beneath them, across his back and shoulders. Every attempt to burn himself clean drove it deeper. In the end the rot held him: Mortem in the decay, Flammeus in the fire that still breaks through it. The people who had once sent for him walled him into stone. Nothing left in the body answers to the man, and the record has called Putriciel "they" ever since. At intervals the rot stills and their old will surfaces as flame. Absolved in that window, Putriciel is purified and rests for a time. The rot always takes them back.
